lessons.title: Introduction to Multi-Model AI
lessons.description: In this lesson, students will be introduced to the concept of Multi-Model AI. The lesson will cover the basics of what Multi-Model AI is, its importance in AI development, and how it differs from traditional AI. Students will also learn about the different types of models used in Multi-Model AI and how they work together to solve complex problems. The lesson will include interactive activities to help students understand the concepts better.
